cover_headline: US Loses Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years as Cases Pass 5,400
facts: The CDC counted 5,412 confirmed US cases in 2026 as of November 12
96% of infections were in people unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status
The CDC schedule is a first MMR dose at 12 months and a second at 4 to 6 years

end.headline: US Loses Measles Elimination Status After 26 Years as Cases Pass 5,400
end.line: PAHO ruled on November 17 that measles has circulated uninterrupted in the United States for more than a year.
